sql: with a as ( select pt.market_ticker tk, split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',2) contest, split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',3) rung, pt.strategy bk, pt.created_at cr, case when pt.side='no' then 100-pt.assumed_price else pt.assumed_price end ypx, pt.pnl::float pnl from paper_trades pt where pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl') and not coalesce(pt.legacy,false) and pt.pnl is not null and pt.strategy not in (select twin_tag from live_paper_twins) and pt.market_ticker like 'KXALBUMEQUIV-%' ), perbook as ( select bk, contest, count(distinct rung) rungs, sum(pnl) p, min(cr)::date d, count(*) filter (where pnl<0) lost from a group by 1,2 ) select 'J_rungs_per_book'::text sec, rungs::text k, count(*)::text book_contests, round(sum(p)::numeric,2)::text pnl, sum(lost)::text lost_trades, string_agg(distinct bk,',' order by bk) books from perbook group by 2 union all select 'K_worst', bk||'/'||contest, rungs::text, round(p::numeric,2)::text, lost::text, d::text from perbook where p < -1.0 order by 1,2
purpose: KXALBUMEQUIV: how many ladder rungs one book held on one album event
